record.question: If the business continues to lose money, I'm afraid we'll have to __________.
record.explanation: Answer A: close down. A business that can no longer continue may close down (A). Independent check: “Close down” is the standard phrasal verb for stopping a business from operating. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/close-down. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
